title: Finally completed the tri-fecta!  So cool to see 3 amazing, but wholl...
transcript: I have now seen all three Normas in Sunset Boulevard on Broadway. So that includes Nicole Scherzinger, Mandy Gonzalez, and now Caroline Bowman, who just went on for her first and probably last time. And while all three actresses are incredible, they each bring something so unique to the role. Like, Nicole really leans into the kookiness of Norma. Her Norma is cracked from the beginning, but also completely transfixing. And then, of course, you also have the madness of Nicole's casting that you just don't get with the other two. Mandy, on the other hand, is giving a much more grounded Norma. I think of the three interpretations, Mandy's was the one that felt the most like a real person, and you really watch her unravel throughout the course of the show. And then you have Caroline, who kind of sits somewhere in the middle between those two interpretations. She's definitely giving a more grounded Norma than Nicole's, while at the same time having a lot of fun with the comedy of the role. I think of the three, she is probably the funniest Norma. I also felt like Caroline really leaned into the seduction of the character. Her Norma feels like someone who has consistently used seduction as a means to get what she wants. And then over the course of the show, we see that seduction turn into desperation. Also, elephant in the room, Caroline is only 35, so she is significantly younger than the other two. Normas and certainly reads younger on stage, no matter how garishly they try to light her face. But to be honest, I got over that pretty quickly, and it didn't really bother me at all. And so you have Nicole, who is just kind of crazy from the jump. You have Mandy, who slowly unravels throughout the course of the show, and then you have Caroline's who just snaps towards the end of the show. I love how different these three interpretations are while still being completely valid in their own right. And it's really hard to choose a favorite, cause I think all three are giving phenomenal performances that each bring something unique to the table.
